clips.send: Someone stuck at the same income for years sends this to a friend who thinks wealth is just luck, proof there's a measurable, physical reason some brains attract money and others don't.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says researchers found something they do not want you to know: the hippocampus, a part of the brain, is measurably bigger in people with at least $100 million in cash than in the average person.

Not 100 or 200 thousand dollars a year in income. Cash. Real, liquid, $100-million-and-up money.

The difference Kevin cites is not small either - 30, 40, 50, sometimes even 100 percent larger than the average brain.

His claim: the hippocampus works like a transmitter, and a bigger one broadcasts a stronger signal into the world.

If the size were not fixed, what would you do differently to grow yours?

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #lawofattraction #millionairemindset #brainscience #manifestation

clips.send: Someone who hasn't finished a book in years sends this to a friend who says reading doesn't matter anymore, proof the gap between readers and everyone else was never an accident.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says there is a reason the wealthy and powerful have always kept the rest of the population from reading well: an illiterate population cannot gain knowledge, and it cannot stimulate the part of the brain reading activates.

He is not talking about homework. Novels count. Biographies count. Any story that forces your mind to build pictures works on the same part of the brain.

Kevin's line: leaders are always readers. Losers are not readers.

It costs nothing and takes no talent, only a decision to actually pick the book up.

When is the last time you finished one?

#kevintrudeau #readmorebooks #wealthmindset #successhabits #selfimprovement #billionairemindset

clips.send: Someone glued to their desk all week sends this to a friend who never leaves the city, proof that a walk in the woods is doing more than clearing your head.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says wealthy people have, for generations, done one thing almost by instinct: spent time outdoors, walking or riding through nature.

His claim is that nature's repeating sounds - running water, crickets, frogs, birds - stimulate the hippocampus, the part of the brain tied to manifesting goals.

Forests add something else: wind moving through trees produces negative ions, which Kevin says stimulate that same part of the brain even further.

None of it costs money. A walk by a creek or a swim in the ocean does the same thing, he says.

When was the last time you spent real time outside, away from screens?

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #lawofattraction #manifestation #naturetherapy #mindsetmatters
